snippet.title: Legend of Baboo - Galaxies Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: The Legend of Baboo is an upcoming mystical action-adventure game developed by Permanent Way and published by Midwest Games, set to release in 2025 for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC. The game follows Sepehr and his loyal dog Baboo as they embark on a journey to save their island from a demonic invasion. Players can switch between the two characters, utilizing their unique abilities to overcome enemies, solve puzzles, and explore enchanted environments. The game features RPG-inspired skill trees, customizable outfits for Baboo, and a variety of magical attacks unlocked by defeating bosses
